thread:
sasha: Observed a weird spike in cache misses after the demotion refactor in canary-3 this morning. tenant A went from 5% miss -> 22% over 10m window.

mike: saw the same briefly during the rollout. looks like demote path might be failing to honor the residency epoch for a small subset of prefixes.

leah: can you paste the minimal log snippet?

sasha: sure — snip: 
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] prefix=tenantA/foo demote:start epoch=42 lease=lv-17
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] prefix=tenantA/foo demote:evict-check fail=epoch-mismatch cur=41 expected=42
[2026-03-20T09:12:04Z] prefix=tenantA/foo respond:cache-miss routed-to=backend
```

jim: epoch-mismatch on demote-check means the demote decision reads stale residency metadata. could be a read-after-write hole when the sequencer updates epoch and demote runs concurrently.

mike: i think the refactor split the demote decision into two RPCs: (1) check residency epoch, (2) issue demote token. there might be a race where a concurrent takeover bumps epoch between the two calls.

maria: that matches tenant A's pattern — frequent ownership handovers for that hot key. i can repro locally with a tiny harness that races takeover and demote.

leah: options: (a) make demote atomic (single RPC that validates epoch and returns token) (b) add lease pinned read that prevents epoch bump until demote completes (c) change demote to be idempotent/forward-compatible so stale reads don't cause misses.

mike: (a) sounds simplest but adds a coupling to the ownership service API. (b) will increase contention on hot handoffs. (c) might be best long-term — demote becomes a no-op if epoch advanced and caches fall back to slow path but keep residency consistent.

ops-bot: deploy status: canary-3 rolled back at 09:20 due to miss-rate alert.

sasha: rolling back confirmed restored baseline. we should still ship a fix before next canary. proposal: quick patch to make demote checks retry on epoch mismatch with exponential backoff (<=50ms, 3 attempts) and add counters. longer term follow-up RFC to unify demote-check into single ownership API.

jim: +1 to retry + metrics. add a debug flag to force atomic demote in test clusters so we can validate perf impact.

maria: i'll open a PR for the retry patch and a leak-proof telemetry dashboard for demote-retries by prefix. assign to @mike for review.

mike: ack. i'll also add a small unit test exercising race where takeover bumps epoch mid-demote.

leah: after PR, let's run a focused canary on tenantA's workload pattern. if retries solve it, we can schedule the RFC for the atomic API next sprint. :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks — filing followups: PR, canary plan, RFC stub.
